Text: Select a reel to roll again.
Add 1 to a displayed digit (9 becomes 0).
Subtract 1 from a displayed digit (0 becomes 9), or count down a Bomb.
Replace a digit with 9 minus that digit.
Swap the displayed values of two different reels, including grey values.
Double a digit, keeping only the last digit.
Copy one reel's displayed value onto a different reel for this spin.
Reroll a reel and both neighbors. The first and last reels are neighbors.
Respin all reels.
Set any reel to 7.
Set any reel to 8.
Copy a reel's displayed value onto both neighbors for this spin. The first and last reels are neighbors.
Permanently replace the displayed reel slot with a Bomb starting at 3. Each later landing or Decrement counts it down. At 0, remove that slot and gain $100.
Permanently replace the displayed reel slot with W. Each W on the final board adds $50 to your cash reward if you meet the goal.
Trigger a non-passive trinket's abilities using the current reels. The Silent resolves when the spin is scored. No Tools! gives no points when targeted directly.
Permanently remove the displayed slot from a reel, leaving it blank until changed or rerolled.
Permanently increase a number on a reel.
Permanently add one exact copy of a trinket, including its current power and progress. Does not trigger acquisition abilities.
Spend $15 to give another tool one more use this spin. Legendary tools cost $150 to refresh.
Keep this reel's displayed value throughout the next spin, including rerolls, even if it is absent from the reel's pool.
Permanently replace the displayed reel slot with Superposition. When it appears, choose 0 or 1; it is grey until chosen. Choosing does not trigger seen abilities.
Transform one non-Token trinket copy into an unowned trinket of the same rarity. Falling Leaves cannot transform. Becomes Bug if none is available.
Transform one trinket copy into an unowned trinket one rarity higher; Legendary stays Legendary. Cannot target Tokens, Bug, or Falling Leaves. If none is available, gain Bug and keep the original.
Add 1 to every displayed digit (9 becomes 0). Skips Bombs and grey values.
Subtract 1 from every displayed digit (0 becomes 9) and count down all displayed Bombs. Skips grey values.
Sell one trinket copy for $35.
Store a displayed digit without removing it. On a later use, place it on any reel for that spin and empty the Jar. Stored digits carry between spins.
Permanently add one copy of a Common or Uncommon trinket. Does not trigger acquisition abilities.
Transform one trinket copy into a Frog that pays $10 after each spin. Cannot transform Falling Leaves. Replication Experiment cannot copy Frogs.
Spend $30 to permanently remove the displayed reel slot, leaving it blank until changed or rerolled.
Permanently remove the displayed reel slot if its digit is 2 or less, leaving the reel blank until changed or rerolled.
Permanently remove the displayed reel slot if its digit is 7 or more, leaving the reel blank until changed or rerolled.
